Below 1 LuminPack is faster. Every ratio compares two libraries in the same process, fixture and operation; groups weight their pairs equally.
Pairs exclude reference fixtures that fail round-trip validation. System.Text.Json has no root reuse operation, so its Reuse row is absent.
